docs.title: Fixed race in session cache
docs.narrative: Concurrent map writes in the session cache caused panics; guarded with a RWMutex.

docs.title: Chose SQLite WAL mode
docs.narrative: WAL lets readers proceed while a writer commits, so hooks can query during writes.

docs.title: Added Prometheus metrics endpoint
docs.narrative: Exposes request latency histograms and error counters at /metrics for scraping.

docs.title: Fixed memory leak in websocket hub
docs.narrative: Goroutines were never released when clients disconnected; added context cancellation.

docs.title: Extracted retry helper with backoff
docs.narrative: Exponential backoff with jitter now lives in one function used by all HTTP callers.

docs.title: Use argon2id for password hashing
docs.narrative: bcrypt cost was too low for new hardware; argon2id with 64MB memory chosen.

docs.title: Dark mode toggle in dashboard
docs.narrative: Theme preference persists in localStorage and follows prefers-color-scheme by default.

docs.title: Kubernetes readiness probe timing
docs.narrative: Pods were killed during warmup because the readiness probe fired before the model loaded.

docs.title: Fixed off-by-one in pagination
docs.narrative: The last page skipped one row when total count was an exact multiple of page size.

docs.title: Adopted table-driven tests
docs.narrative: Subtests with named cases make failures easier to locate and new cases cheap to add.

docs.title: Rate limiting middleware
docs.narrative: Token bucket per client IP returns 429 with a Retry-After header when exceeded.

docs.title: Fixed timezone bug in scheduler
docs.narrative: Cron jobs fired an hour late after daylight saving because times were stored in local zone.

docs.title: Slow query caused by missing index
docs.narrative: EXPLAIN showed a sequential scan on the events table; a composite index cut it from 900ms to 4ms.

docs.title: Split monolithic handler file
docs.narrative: The 3000 line handlers file was divided by domain: sessions, observations, search.

docs.title: Embeddings computed locally with ONNX
docs.narrative: Avoids sending user text to third parties and works offline.

docs.title: Export observations as JSON
docs.narrative: New CLI command dumps all stored observations to a portable JSON file for backup.

docs.title: Fixed CORS preflight failure
docs.narrative: OPTIONS requests were rejected by auth middleware; moved CORS handling before authentication.

docs.title: Docker image size dominated by build cache
docs.narrative: Multi-stage build with a distroless runtime reduced the image from 1.2GB to 80MB.

docs.title: Structured logging with zerolog
docs.narrative: JSON logs with fields are easier to filter in aggregation than free-form strings.

docs.title: Full text search with FTS5
docs.narrative: Keyword queries use SQLite FTS5 with porter stemming alongside vector similarity.

docs.title: Fixed panic on nil config
docs.narrative: Missing settings file returned a nil pointer; defaults are now loaded instead.

docs.title: GC pauses from large slices
docs.narrative: Preallocating slice capacity removed repeated growth and lowered p99 latency.

docs.title: Graceful shutdown on SIGTERM
docs.narrative: Server drains in-flight requests for 30 seconds before exiting so deploys drop nothing.

docs.title: Replaced global state with dependency injection
docs.narrative: Services receive their stores through constructors, which makes tests independent.

docs.title: OAuth login with GitHub
docs.narrative: Users authenticate via the GitHub authorization code flow and receive a session cookie.

docs.title: Fixed flaky integration test
docs.narrative: The test relied on sleep; replaced with polling on a readiness condition.

docs.title: Git hooks slowed commits
docs.narrative: Pre-commit ran the full test suite; limited it to changed packages.

docs.title: Pinned dependency versions
docs.narrative: Lockfile committed and CI uses frozen installs to keep builds reproducible.

docs.title: Webhook retries with dead letter queue
docs.narrative: Failed deliveries retry five times and then land in a dead letter table for inspection.

docs.title: Unicode normalization broke search
docs.narrative: Accented characters did not match until queries and content were NFC normalized.
